name: serialized-values-stored-as-unknown
description: Where the serialization walk meets unknown, it walks each value the program stores there at that value's own type: a value assigned to an index of a Record of unknown, a value an object literal writes into a property typed unknown, a value an array literal of unknown holds and a value assigned to a variable declared unknown, each container then serialized, keep their data members. A value stored in a container of another type that is never serialized keeps nothing, so its member is still reported as written and never read.
